input.quote: 11.1 Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
input.rationale: Section 11.1 is walk-away territory: it requires immediate cessation of all assistance and permanent deletion of Customer Data with no export or migration support, and it contradicts 11.2 (30-day machine-readable return) and 11.3 (deletion and written certification after confirmed return). The Agreement contains no transition assistance period anywhere (10.1 merely refers to "any agreed transition period"), so the fallback 90 days of assistance is also unmet, and 11.2's return runs from Customer's request rather than expiry or termination. Because the machine-readable format and post-return certified deletion elements are already met in 11.2 and 11.3, we target the preferred level with two surgical edits: 11.1 becomes up to six months of assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, and 11.2's 30-day return is anchored to expiry or termination (retaining the request trigger and all other wording verbatim).

proposal.summary: Replace immediate cessation/deletion in 11.1 with six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, and anchor the 30-day data return to expiry or termination.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept immediate discontinuation of assistance and deletion of Customer Data with no export, which also contradicts the 30-day return and certified-deletion mechanics in 11.2 and 11.3. We have replaced 11.1 with up to six months of transition assistance at your then-current rates and anchored the 30-day return to expiry or termination; 90 days of assistance is our fallback.

ops.oldText: Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
ops.newText: On expiry or termination, Vendor shall provide transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates.

ops.oldText: Within thirty days after Customer's request, Vendor
ops.newText: Within thirty days after expiry, termination, or Customer's request, Vendor

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
mappings.quote: Vendor shall return all Customer Data in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format, with relationships and metadata reasonably necessary for use.

mappings.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
mappings.quote: After Customer confirms successful return, Vendor shall securely delete remaining Customer Data from active systems and, as backups cycle, from backups, except for a copy required by Applicable Law. An authorized officer shall certify deletion in writing.
